stories.name: Sneha
stories.body: My problem is finally sorted. I'm so grateful to Dr Rajveer for his care.

stories.name: Naresh
stories.body: If you have sacrum, coccyx or tailbone pain in Bengaluru, he's the person I'd send you to.

stories.name: Ishwinder Pal Singh
stories.body: Few people in India or the Middle East practise Internal Manipulation. Our whole family is thankful we found him.

stories.name: Sudarshan
stories.body: He replies to calls, texts and email. The procedure was quick and neither painful nor embarrassing.

stories.name: Anshuman
stories.body: One visit was all it took to sort out my problem.

stories.name: Suman
stories.body: About 70% better by day ten of following his advice, and 90–95% after two months.

stories.name: Rasheeda
stories.body: The female doctor trained under Dr Rajveer made me feel completely at ease.

stories.name: Fatima
stories.body: This pain can really wear you down. His diagnosis and treatment plan gave me my life back.

stories.name: Sachin
stories.body: He clearly understands coccyx injuries and their complications. His guidance was excellent.
